objective:
【研究命题·纯机器学习/数学】

解空间刚性 = 满足全部解析约束的函数集合的维数：低维/唯一 = 刚，高维/连续族 = 胖。

核心问题：小型前馈网络的“泛化行为”能否作为 bootstrap 解空间刚性的探针？
令 w = 约束样本数，N_c(w) = 在未参与训练的留出约束点上取得“零违规”所需的最小网络容量（用隐藏层宽度度量）。

【唯一硬性口径（不可更改，其余全由你决定）】
- 零违规 = 留出约束点上的最大绝对误差 ≤ 1e-3。
- 刚性 = 扫描范围内存在较小的有限 N_c（且 N_c 不随 w 增长）；胖 = 扫描上限内任何宽度都达不到零违规（N_c 不可达）。判别是二值的。
- 所有报告数值必须是有限数（禁止 inf/nan/None）。
- 研究对象只能是小型前馈网络本身。严禁把本命题替换或“换名归约”为材料/化学/玻璃/合金/离子导电等任何物理体系，也不要用别的领域类比回答。

【实验的族、样本、扫描、脚本如何设计，以及如何证明“刚性可达”，由你自己决定并给出理由。】

所有结论必须来自真实运行的可复现数值实验：给出扫描设置、训练与留出误差数值、以及 N_c(w) 的数值与趋势。

input_params.description: Execute a numerical scan to test the Algebraic Variety Hypothesis regarding solution space rigidity in small feedforward networks. The plan involves: (1) generating a synthetic system of w algebraic constraints (polynomial equations) that form a zero-dimensional variety when w ≥ d (dimension of input space); (2) training small MLPs with varying hidden widths N to satisfy these constraints on training points; (3) evaluating generalization error on held-out test points; (4) identifying the minimum width N_c(w) achieving zero violation (max abs error ≤ 1e-3); (5) plotting N_c(w) vs w to distinguish between constant (rigid), polynomial (fat), or logarithmic scaling. The experiment will use PyTorch for network training and numpy for constraint generation.
input_params.expected_prediction: If the Algebraic Variety Hypothesis holds, N_c(w) will remain constant (small finite value) for w beyond a threshold, indicating a rigid solution space. If the Approximation Theory Hypothesis holds, N_c(w) will grow polynomially with w. The Landscape Conditioning Hypothesis predicts logarithmic growth. The scan will reveal which scaling law fits the empirical data.
